verdict.rationale: Airwallex explicitly supports batch/bulk operations, notably Batch Transfers for creating multiple payouts to multiple beneficiaries across currencies/countries in one operation, plus APIs for cards, bills, and accounts that can be scripted for bulk use via SDKs/CLI/AgentOS. missing for 10: no explicit bulk endpoints for card issuance or connected-account creation, and no independent/hands-on benchmark of bulk throughput or limits.
